resolve_src_string: pass a string path to _resolve_src and get the same string path back unchanged
resolve_src_memoryview: pass a bytes buffer to _resolve_src and get a memoryview of the bytes back
resolve_src_pathlib: pass a pathlib Path object to _resolve_src and get its string path via os.fspath
resolve_src_torch_tensor: pass a torch tensor to _resolve_src and get a memoryview of its numpy array data
resolve_src_invalid_type: pass an unsupported object to _resolve_src and get a TypeError with diagnostic details
